tools.name: search_builds
tools.description: Search RigBase measured home AI builds. Filter by GPU name, model name, minimum VRAM (GB), and/or maximum build cost. Returns top matches with tok/s, quant, engine, source credit and canonical getrigbase.com URL. Never invents numbers.

tools.name: can_it_run
tools.description: Ask whether a given GPU setup can run a model. Returns measured RigBase results when available; otherwise a VRAM-fit estimate clearly labelled as an estimate (weights arithmetic, not a measured speed). Advises against quants below Q4. Always includes source credit and URLs for measured rows.

tools.name: best_gpu_for_model
tools.description: Return the fastest measured RigBase result for a model, plus tok/s per euro where a build cost or known GPU street price exists. Includes source credit and canonical URL.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Fetch one RigBase build by slug (e.g. "dual-3090-ryzen-3700x"). Returns parts, measured results, source credit and canonical URL.
